generalAbilities.name: Soundsense (Precise) 60 feet
generalAbilities.description: An oppali's sense of hearing is a precise sense to a range of 60 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Energizing Incompetence
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet critically fails an attack against the oppali

Effect The attack instead becomes a failure, and the oppali becomes Quickened 1 for 1 round. It can use this extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drain Luck
offensiveAbilities.description:
A creature other than an animal or plant hit by an oppali's vine Strike must attempt a DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw twice, taking the lower result as the actual result.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Drain Luck for 24 hours.

Success The creature takes 2d6 Poison Damage damage. Until the start of the creature's next turn, the creature must roll twice and take the worse result on all checks.

Effect: Drain Luck (Success)

Failure The creature takes 2d6 Persistent,poison Damage damage. For 1 round, the creature must roll twice and take the worse result on all checks.

Effect: Drain Luck (Failure)

Critical Failure The creature takes 4d6 Persistent,poison Damage damage. For 1 minute, the creature must roll twice and take the worse result on all checks.

Effect: Drain Luck (Critical Failure)

offensiveAbilities.name: Trumpet Blast
offensiveAbilities.description: The oppali emits a massive blast of discordant noise that deals 9d8 Sonic Damage damage to creatures within a 60ft Cone (Basic DC 29 Fortitude Saving Throw). Creatures who fail the save are also Deafened for 1 round. The oppali can't use its Trumpet Blast again for 1d4 rounds or until it takes at least 20 points of sonic damage from a single source (whichever comes first).
